patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than Snov.io's shape. Choose Snov.io only if your buying job matches “Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter fr” rather than Kaspr's shape. Workflow advantage: Kaspr leans lead-management; Snov.io leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline.; Snov.io is Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter from $39/mo..
- Company-size focus: Kaspr (small-business, mid-market) vs Snov.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Kaspr-leaning lead-management vs Snov.io-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Snov.io — No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led.

Limitations — Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms; Snov.io: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led; Contact database depth is lighter than ZoomInfo/Apollo-class breadth claims.

Poor-fit cases: Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies · Snov.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led · Avoid Kaspr if you actually need Snov.io's motion (Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
